source_caption:
Law Abiding Citizen — Revenge Against the System

Law Abiding Citizen (2009) follows Clyde Shelton, a man whose life is shattered after his wife and daughter are murdered during a home invasion. When the justice system fails to give him the outcome he believes his family deserves, Clyde becomes determined to make those responsible pay.

Years later, Clyde begins executing an elaborate plan aimed not only at the people directly involved, but also at the legal system he believes betrayed him. Prosecutor Nick Rice is forced to confront Clyde, who seems to have planned every move long before anyone realizes what is happening.

As the conflict escalates, Clyde's actions become increasingly difficult to predict. Nick must race to uncover how Clyde's plans work while trying to stop the destruction before more people are caught in the middle.

The film explores themes of justice, revenge, morality, corruption, and the consequences of losing faith in the legal system. It constantly questions where justice ends and revenge begins.

What makes Law Abiding Citizen compelling is the psychological battle between Clyde and Nick. Each man believes he understands the other, but every discovery reveals another layer of Clyde's plan.

💬 When justice fails, revenge can become a dangerous game with no easy way out.

source_details.synopsis: Law Abiding Citizen is a 2009 American vigilante action thriller film directed by F. Gary Gray and written by Kurt Wimmer. The film stars Jamie Foxx, Gerard Butler, Bruce McGill, Colm Meaney, Leslie Bibb, Regina Hall, Michael Irby, Christian Stolte, and Josh Stewart. Set in Philadelphia, it follows Clyde Shelton (Butler), a man who witnesses the rape and murder of his wife and daughter during a home invasion.
